_caveat: FA FIDELITY REFERENCE — NOT a production behavioral target.

Source: measure-forced-alignment-hf.py (transformers Wav2Vec2ForCTC, jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-english), run with pad-sec=3.0 and neighbour-midpoint windowing (align_segment's floor_bound/ceil_bound clamp) — this is MEASUREMENT convention, chosen to keep one segment's alignment window from bleeding into a neighbour's real speech during this measurement pass.

R.4 (sync-pipeline-v2-plan.md) specifies PAD_BASE 0.75s for production. The audit that led to R.4 traced the midpoint-clamp windowing strategy used here to five documented failures on gapless corpora (docs/history.md) — this baseline's windowing is NOT what production should do.

Therefore: this is a FIDELITY reference for the Rust jonatasgrosman/ONNX/Viterbi port to reproduce this model's own achievable output on this input, NOT a behavioral target for what Apply Sync should commit. Do not wire this baseline's numbers into a production-timing comparison.

R-Q REGENERATION (docs/work-in-progress.md, this session): this fixture previously used torchaudio's MMS_FA bundle (CC-BY-NC-4.0, barred from shipping by Decision 3). It has been regenerated here against jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-english (Apache-2.0) — the actual model family production ships — resolving R-Q's stated obligation. The prior MMS-FA capture's own numbers are superseded; retrieve them from git history if a historical comparison is ever needed.

This baseline captures the FIRST run of this HF-harness/jonatasgrosman pairing against these three projects' committed segments — there is nothing to diff it against yet; this run establishes the reference.
Production ships jonatasgrosman/wav2vec2-large-xlsr-53-{en,es,fr,de,pt}, with per-language CTC vocabs of 33 (en) / 41 (es) / 59 (fr) / 38 (de) / 46 (pt) symbols.

This fixture IS now a valid reference for text normalization and vocab coverage too (unlike its MMS-FA predecessor), since it uses the real shipping model's own alphabet — though it still measures via transformers/torchaudio's forced_align, not this repo's own Rust Viterbi port; the Rust port's own fidelity is independently verified by fa-onnx-emission-*.json/fa-e2e-alignment-*.json (zero-tolerance parity, Slices D2/D4), which this fixture does not replace or duplicate.
